entry.title: on proprietary data
entry.content:
A quick write-up on proprietary data, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Proprietary data shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
